name: Fly.io
description: Deploys and runs apps on Fly Machines through the Machines REST API, the flyctl CLI, and a flyctl MCP server, for developers and agents managing app infrastructure.

skills.name: Fly Launch
skills.description: Configures and deploys an app from source with fly launch.

skills.name: Machines API
skills.description: Creates, starts, stops, and manages Fly Machines, apps, volumes, and certificates over REST.

skills.name: Fly Volumes
skills.description: Attaches persistent storage volumes to Fly Machines.

skills.name: Managed Postgres
skills.description: Creates and connects to Fly Managed Postgres clusters.

skills.name: flyctl MCP Server
skills.description: Exposes apps, certs, logs, machines, orgs, secrets, status, and volumes commands to MCP clients via fly mcp server.
